title.narrative: Digital Technologies for Civic Empowerment in Kyrgyzstan (DC4TE)

description.narrative: The Action is expected to reach at least 10 youths, women, and human rights NGOs and create 500+ accounts for citizens from different regions on e-platforms. At least 300 citizens, particularly young people, women, and the disabled will directly gain knowledge on innovative ways of interaction with the state and contribution to good governance. Public bodies, businesses and the media will benefit directly from capacity-building activities and tools for good governance developed under this action. The funding organization is the Delegation of the European Union to the Kyrgyz Republic. Value of the contract EUR 1,052,632.
